Our platform integrates directly into existing university systems (SIS, LMS, CRM), learns each institution’s unique workflows, and deploys specialized AI agents. This dramatically reduces the $735 billion universities spend annually on administrative labor, expands staff capacity without increasing headcount, and improves the student experience.

This hasn't been done before because university workflows require nuanced, autonomous judgment, exactly what agentic AI was designed to solve. Our team uniquely combines deep expertise in higher education, enterprise-scale AI, and regulated enterprise sales.

Sadia previously built Salesforce’s Education Cloud from scratch, creating the core Student Information System widely used across higher education. She deeply understands university operations and maintains trusted relationships with hundreds of higher-ed CIOs and Provosts.

Danial was one of DoorDash’s earliest engineers, where he architected and scaled complex systems from zero to billions of transactions, including their search, recommendation, and Voice AI platforms. He knows how to build robust AI solutions that reliably perform at enterprise scale. 

Shahryar was a GM at Airwallex, where he built the entire Americas business from 0 to 1 and drove 11x revenue growth.  He’s also a master closer, single-handedly securing over $17M in enterprise deals at NerdWallet.  He’s a relentless startup executor with deep expertise launching and scaling go-to-market machines in highly regulated industries.

We launched six weeks ago and are already at $8k MRR, growing 55% week-over-week -- one of the fastest ramps ever in higher ed. Universities urgently need solutions that expand labor capacity and efficiency, especially as they face unprecedented budget pressure and staffing shortages.

With unmatched buyer access, deep technical expertise, and rapid early traction, we are perfectly positioned to own this enormous market.

name: Robocurve
one_liner: Evals for robots
description:
Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust.

Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits.

Good benchmarks require operating and maintaining physical hardware and real-world setups. Simulation only goes so far, since models that look strong in sim can show large performance gaps once deployed in the real world. Building real-world benchmarks means coordinating job-domain experts, evals engineering, and hands-on robotics all at once.

Frontier labs are targeting general-purpose robotics by 2028, yet the field of robotics evals barely exists. Whoever builds the trusted measure of robot capability becomes the reference everyone relies on. We combine backgrounds in AI evals and robotics to build and grow this field as fast as possible. We already shipped v1 of our open-source framework, Inspect Robots, and ran our first pilot scoring a frontier model on a real robot.

name: RocketLit
one_liner: RocketLit is an adaptive learning and assessment platform.
description:
RocketLit gives all students better access to learning and educators access to the data they need to be most impactful.

Our first product, RocketLit, is an adaptive and personalized learning platform that serves reading to students at their independent level. Students read the same content at different levels of complexity and fluidly move up reading levels as they improve.

InnerOrbit is our new Science Assessment platform, giving students, teachers and administrators the practice and data they need to be successful on science tests. We serve the highest quality content and feature the most detailed reporting on the market. 

We’re a small and focused team working to change the world through science education. Our company has served over 650k students and we’re on track to more than double that number in the next year. We’re looking for folks who’ll grow into a leadership role within the organization.

name: Roundabout Technologies
one_liner: Software for AI-powered traffic lights
description: Roundabout Technologies makes AI-powered traffic lights, allowing cities to reduce pedestrian deaths, improve traffic, and reduce resident complaints. Our founding team has experience building safety-critical embedded systems and AI at Waymo, Zoox, Google, and Verily.

name: Salem Robotics Inc
one_liner: Deploying robots to replace workers in hazardous spaces
description: Our software turns any robot we deploy into an everyday independent worker at your facility. They are able to walk sites, handle instruments, overcome obstacles, collect measurements, and generate auditable compliance records, replacing hours of mandatory manual surveys and inspections. Built by Los Alamos robotics veterans and deterministic-manipulation researchers, we started in nuclear and are already expanding to other hazardous industries.

name: Serinus Biosciences
one_liner: Combinations therapy by rational design
description: Serinus Biosciences is tackling one of the toughest problems in cancer treatment: creating combination therapies to override treatment resistance. We leverage cutting edge technology to design a fully explainable AI platform primed with decades of system biology knowledge. Uniquely powered for biological inference, our AI engine uncovers how cancer cells evolve treatment resistance and identifies molecules to overcome resistance escape routes. We design combinations that are safer, more effective, and can get to patients quickly. Founded by MIT PhDs and supported by a scientific advisory board of top academics from the Broad Institute, Dana-Farber, and UCSD, Serinus is powered by Y Combinator and other top investors to revolutionize precision medicine.

name: Shift Health
one_liner: Turn manual healthcare process into automated workflows
description: We help large provider groups and hospitals take their most mundane repetitive tasks and turn them into automated workflows. Freeing up healthcare workers to focus on the important stuff, like patients

name: shotwell.ai
one_liner: Annotations for robotics data
description: Shotwell AI is building the data QA layer for dexterous robotics. We work with teams collecting teleoperation and egocentric data to provide dense semantic annotation and validate task adherence. This lets teams compress feedback loops from weeks to hours and iterate on models much faster.

name: Sift
one_liner: The Leader in Digital Trust & Safety
description: Sift is the leader in Digital Trust & Safety, empowering digital disruptors to Fortune 500 companies to unlock new revenue without risk. Sift dynamically prevents fraud and abuse through industry-leading technology and expertise, an unrivaled global data network of 70 billion events per month, and a commitment to long-term customer partnerships. Global brands such as DoorDash, Twitter, and Wayfair rely on Sift to gain a competitive advantage in their markets.

name: SigmaOS
one_liner: The new home for your internet 🏡
description:
SigmaOS is a new type of browser designed for founders, researchers, and content creators to make you better and faster at working on the web.

You work 7+ hours a day on the web. Buried in a sea of 100+ tabs and 10+ web-apps 🤯, you constantly lose context for why you did what you did, and are always one click away from being distracted.

We took apart the browser for you, and rebuilt a new experience from the ground-up, for the FASTEST and most PRODUCTIVE work. ⚡

name: Snapdocs
one_liner: digital mortgage closing
description: We're building digital infrastructure and workflow tools to connect the many parties involved in real estate transactions. The result is a more digital, online, and automated process for everyone involved.
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Spark Studio
one_liner: The most magical personal Voice-Led AI English Learning Buddy for Kids
description:
Meet Sparky, a fun and quirky AI buddy in the avatar of a friendly fox who kids can just speak with to build fluency and confidence with English speaking. 
Powered by Generative AI, and made magical with child-appropriate experience, features and topics, Sparky brings a whole world of knowledge and a judgement-free environment for kids to become comfortable with speaking English. 

142 countries (outside English dominant countries) mandate English learning as part of the national education policy. These kids have exposure to English but feel underconfident and embarrassed to speak. The biggest problem across the classes and books they get, is the lack of real conversational practice. With AI, we're making this affordable accessible and enjoyable for kids across the world. 

We're a passionate team of educators with over 30 years of combined experience in building education products for kids and have held leadership positions are India's biggest education companies - Byju's and LEAD.

name: SpruceID
one_liner: SpruceID lets users control their data across the web.
description: SpruceID lets users control their data across the web. Instead of people signing into platforms, we imagine platforms should sign into people’s data vaults. We implement this pattern into digital wallet ecosystems for governments, enterprises, and blockchains. We believe that architectures that enable individual autonomy in the digital world are necessary for free societies and dynamic economies to thrive.

name: StayQrious
one_liner: StayQrious helps kids in India learn through online group classes,…
description: Imagine doing personalised workouts with a fitness coach, but for school subjects. Students log into their session that has been scheduled with their coach, they can see their learning workout for the day. Their workout typically consists of watching an interactive video, writing explanations, giving feedback to other students, making an explainer video etc. They get constant feedback and encouragement from the coach and progress only after they have understood the pre-requisites.

name: Stellar Sleep
one_liner: We help people with chronic insomnia sleep better, using psychology.
description: 25 million Americans with chronic insomnia are getting inadequate and superficial care advice (e.g. cutting coffee, meditation etc.), when in reality, their sleep problems are often driven by deeper psychological challenges like unresolved anxiety. Stellar Sleep uses psychology to help these people break the insomnia cycle.

name: Stralis Aircraft
one_liner: Emission free hydrogen electric aircraft
description: Our planes fly 10 times further than battery electric alternatives, with a lower operating cost than fossil fuel powered aircraft. Our first product is a 15 seat aircraft with a range of 800 km that enters service in 2026 with launch customer Skytrans. Our team has over 85 years of aerospace experience and have developed, flight tested and certified aircraft at Google X, magniX, Heart Aerospace, Ampaire, Airbus, Boeing, Bombardier and Gulfstream. We have $145M in aircraft LOIs from 7 airlines in the US, Europe and Australia.

name: Suiteness
one_liner: Book guaranteed connecting rooms and suites at hotels
description: Suiteness is the first online booking platform with access to an inventory of thousands of exclusive luxury hotel suites. Suiteness is carving a niche for itself in the international travel industry as the leading website dedicated solely to luxury suites and finding success with group travelers and families looking for a nice place to stay together.

name: Sunlight
one_liner: The intelligence and execution layer for agentic B2B card payments.
description:
Sunlight moves B2B payment volume onto card without asking a single supplier to onboard. Our AI agents determine where a bill can be paid by card without a surcharge, then execute that payment through the vendor's own billing or AR portal, returning a confirmed status, receipt, and structured remittance data through a single API.

For decades, moving invoice spend onto card meant building a rail or signing suppliers up one at a time. Both are slow, and both leave most of the volume behind. Sunlight takes a different path. Because our agents pay through the portals suppliers already use, the network reaches every supplier without any of them having to join it.

AP platforms and bank card programs issue their own cards, send them to us, and capture the interchange on volume that would otherwise have defaulted to ACH or check. We are the AI infrastructure layer that makes that volume reachable.

name: Super
one_liner: Super is the first and leading Indonesian social commerce platform
description:
We are building Pinduoduo for Indonesia by enabling community leaders to become retailers within their communities, starting by selling daily products through the Super app. We use technology to: 
1) Help community leaders find the best price 
2) build the lowest cost logistics network 
3) facilitate communication for this social buying behavior

name: Synapse Semiconductor
one_liner: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision
description:
We want to push machines to where humans cant go. 
Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.

name: Taan.ai
one_liner: the most precise & controllable foundation music models
description:
Taan builds foundation music models that do what you tell them to, when you tell them to. We're starting with music for video. Give Taan a video and it watches it, then composes an original score that follows the emotion and timing of every cut. If the scene is tense for 10 seconds and then turns happy, the music changes at that exact moment. You get back a fully mixed .mp4. Agents and apps call Taan through our API, so any video tool can add scored, synced music with one call. 

Today's music models can make catchy tracks, but you can't steer them. Ask for "violin at exactly the 11th second" and they usually skip it. We trained Taan from the ground up for control. 

We measured Taan on prompt adherence and instruction success. And against every leading model we tested, Taan was at least 4x better.  

We work with teams building video agents, ad and creative tools, micro-dramas and games. We're musicians and ML researchers. Adithya (CEO) comes from eight generations of Indian classical musicians, tours as a metal guitarist, has done music ML research since 2023, and has filed two patents on music generation architectures. Devansh (CTO) did signal-processing research at IIT Kanpur and was previously an ML engineer at American Express.

name: Tegore
one_liner: Your new AI-powered math tutor.
description:
Tegore follows K-12 school curriculum to design courses like Algebra I & Algebra II. In addition to working with high schools in the Bay Area to design the best in-classroom experiences, Tegore is developing the corresponding consumer product, a Duolingo for Math.

Each lesson in Tegore follows a lesson plan (e.g. Polynomial Long Division), and the content is delivered with voice / interactive visuals, and checks students' understanding by using dialectic teaching.

name: Tekton Dynamics
one_liner: AI control layer for welding robots
description:
Our mission is to empower every manufacturer, no matter their scale, to invent and build anything using intelligent robots.

Today’s industrial robots are fast but "blind". They struggle with any task that isn't perfectly repetitive. We are building the eyes and brain (a proprietary vision system and AI model) that allow industrial robots to see, reason, and perform complex work with sub-millimeter accuracy and the adaptability of a human expert.

We are witnessing the start of a new industrial revolution: an era of advanced manufacturing powered by AI and robotics. We aim to lead this shift by putting these tools into the hands of every manufacturer, ensuring the power to invent and build at scale isn’t a privilege of the few.

name: Telamont
one_liner: AI that catches errors in construction documents
description:
Construction projects lose money in the gap between what the documents say and what gets built. One missed discrepancy between the specs, drawings, geotechnical study and code can become a seven-figure claim eighteen months later.

Telamont catches contractual, technical and code-compliance risks in construction documents and gives teams the system to act on them before they become costly rework or disputes.

Telamont connects to where your documents live and pulls in every file and revision as it lands, continuously building a complete picture of the project. Every page is checked against the rest of the project, so risks are flagged as soon as they appear. Instead of reviewing documents, teams act on flagged risks, tracking each from detection to resolution while managing exposure and pursuing recovery opportunities across every project.

name: Token Transit
one_liner: Complete fare payment platform for public transportation
description:
Token Transit puts cities in the center of managing new mobility by providing a complete fare payment platform for public transportation.

Token Transit launched our mobile ticketing app in 2016. We now provide payments for transportation in over 200 cities across the United States and Canada with integration into the major third party trip planning apps such as Transit, Moovit and Google Maps.

name: Toku
one_liner: Account Receivables Platform for Latin American Enterprises
description: Toku helps companies increase their monthly revenue collection rate so they can focus on the their main business. Payment method management, failed payment retries, payment reminders, failed payment notifications, among others.

name: Trusty
one_liner: Limitless Real Estate
description: Trusty is an agent-to-agent matchmaking network that searches every home, regardless of whether it's on the market. This means fresh inventory for buyers, private offers for homeowners, and happy real estate agents.
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Union54
one_liner: Developers of ChitChat, an integrated messaging and payments wallet…
description:
ChitChat by Union54 is an integrated messaging and payments platform designed specifically for Africa's unique needs.

Our app combines secure instant messaging with USD card capabilities and cross-border payments, making international money movement more accessible and affordable.

We're tackling one of Africa's biggest financial challenges: the high cost of sending money across borders, where African senders often pay double the fees despite sending smaller amounts.

As a Y Combinator-backed startup, we're building technology that empowers African consumers and businesses to participate more fully in the global digital economy.

Our mission is to create financial products that genuinely serve customer needs while challenging the status quo of traditional remittance providers.

name: UNISON
one_liner: Live between worlds, in UNISON, using the headset we're building!
description:
UNISON is building a unified reality headset to dive in and resurface from virtual worlds with new-found value.

UNISON is a small team of passionate people from companies like Meta, Sony, Apple and research labs like the IARAI, based in the SF Bay Area and backed by some of the world’s best investors. Learn more about us, our product, and team here: in-unison.com.

name: Usul
one_liner: AI Platform for Winning Defense & Government Contracts
description:
Usul helps companies win government contracts in 60+ nations. 

Our AI monitors $8 trillion in annual government spending and instantly matches you to contracts across defense, IT, energy, healthcare and more.

Learn more at https://usul.com/

name: Valink Therapeutics
one_liner: Discovering bispecific antibody drug-conjugates (BsADC) against cancer
description: Valink Therapeutics develops next generation antibody-based therapeutics. We identify novel mechanism of action from known targets by incorporating multiple antibody modifications at once, rapidly and scalable generating complex drug candidates (bi-/multispecificity, multivalency and drug-conjugation in a single discovery process). Our research focus is on solid tumours poorly addressed by immunotherapy.

name: Ventura
one_liner: AI Workforce for Distributors and Manufacturers
description: Ventura builds the AI workforce for distributors and manufacturers, starting with quoting and order entry. It plugs into your existing ERP, follows your SOPs, and learns your team's tribal knowledge - getting smarter with every completed task.

name: Verdant
one_liner: AI Agents to Make Local Gov Efficient
description:
Verdant sells AI agents to local government to make them more efficient. We're starting with permitting, the highest-volume workflow in local government that requires judgment. 

Many startups fail to sell to government, but not us - we've processed 200+ applications and gone from 0 to 4 paid deployments across 4 states with an average close time of 4 weeks.

name: Veriff
one_liner: Veriff is a global AI-native identity platform building trust online
description:
Veriff is a global AI-native identity platform that helps organizations build trust online. Leading companies across financial services, marketplaces, mobility, gig economy, and other digital sectors rely on Veriff's technology to stay compliant, prevent fraud, protect users, and scale globally.

Veriff's trust infrastructure supports the full customer journey, from verification to ongoing authentication and fraud prevention, with the least friction for honest people. With 600+ people in the US, UK, Brazil, Spain, and Estonia, Veriff helps businesses expand across borders without the complexity of managing identity verification, compliance, and fraud in multiple markets – creating a single source of truth for trusted identities. Backed by investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, Veriff is dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer, more secure world.

name: Vestris
one_liner: The FICO score for homes
description: With the government pushing to make title insurance optional on refinances, lenders are starting to take on title risk. Vestris gives every property a risk assessment, like a credit score for homes, so lenders know what they're lending against and homeowners know where their property stands.
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Voosh
one_liner: Making Restaurants more data-driven!
description: Voosh is a Food Technology company aiming to empower Food Service brands using our proprietary visualisation tools and Data Science. One stop visualisation tool for CXOs, Operational heads or Zonal managers to get business insights and take real time decisions to help grow online sales.

name: Vorticity
one_liner: The Fastest Scientific Computing Platform on the Planet
description:
Many pressing problems facing humanity can be solved with faster scientific compute. Currently, it takes billions of dollars to design and develop a new fusion reactor, a hyper-sonic airplane or a new cancer treatment. This is because scientists and engineers have to build very expensive things before they even know if their ideas work. But what if we can simulate the workings of these ideas (and more) on computers first and have high confidence that it works before we build really expensive things?

The work of humanity's greatest scientists over the years has given us the physics and math to do this. The problem is that we simply do not have the computing power to solve these big problems.

To address this, the Vorticity Inc is re-imagining scientific computing all the way down to processor architecture and system design. Our proven technology is already helping the energy, life sciences and aerospace industries.

name: Warpfy
one_liner: Building Shein of Home: tech-driven, design-mfr Home Lifestyle Brand
description:
The Fine Living Company (Warpfy) is on a mission to revolutionize the $800B home and kitchen market, building a tech-enabled cross-border Home Lifestyle brand from India—think Shein for Home or Williams Sonoma. 
Our Design-to-Manufacture-to-Consumer model cuts out the middlemen, delivering high-quality products directly to consumers (D2C), through marketplaces, and via our proprietary B2B channel, The India Wholesale Company). 
With a fragmented market where 70% is dominated by single-store boutiques and online penetration is just 20%, Home and Kitchen segment is ripe for disruption. India’s share of products has been minimal due to 60%+ value inflation from intermediaries. We’re changing that.
Our full-stack approach: AI Copilot-driven product design, ERP for multi-channel distribution & manufacturer retention, and optimized supply chain—offers unparalleled speed & value.

name: Wayline
one_liner: AI operating system for multifamily leasing, maintenance, and…
description:
A comprehensive system that sorts, sends, and solves issues so every request and booking gets handled immediately, letting you focus on what drives revenue.

Unify disconnected services and tools with a system that gives you humans where they're crucial and AI for everything else. Get instant, automatic, 24/7 replies for all the routine stuff, follow-ups that follow up on their own, and support from real people when you need it.

name: Waypoint Transit
one_liner: We automate urban planning so cities can build cheaper and faster.
description:
Waypoint Transit is an AI city planner that generates civil infrastructure studies. Cities spend $50B/year on planning. With Waypoint, cities can generate reports in months rather than years, and at 30% of the cost.

Varun and Ryan met at Stanford, where they graduated with degrees in CS and EE respectively. Before founding Waypoint, Varun worked on AI at Microsoft and Ryan worked on chip design at Apple.

US cities are facing three major crises: congestion, budget deficits, and climate change. At the same time, city governments are understaffed and frequently need to contract work out to expensive consultants. Leveraging recent advancements in AI, we empower cities to reduce their costs, build infrastructure, and respond to problems quickly.

In the United States, state and local governments spend $50B/year on planning. Through automation, we can redefine the existing transportation and urban planning consulting markets.

For more information, visit waypointtransit.com or contact us at contact@waypointtransit.com.

name: Webiny
one_liner: Open-source framework for building serverless applications
description:
When the public cloud appeared migration was easy. Existing apps running on physical servers could just be moved to virtual machines running in the cloud. The cloud is now moving towards serverless, and serverless is not backward compatible. New tools need to be created and existing apps need to be rewritten. Webiny provides developers with everything they need to build those serverless apps.

We are a 100% remote team.

name: Wefunder
one_liner: We're Robinhood for pre-IPO startups. Everyone can invest $100.
description:
We help everyone invest in startups that they care about.

We believe that when all Americans can invest in innovation, the world will be a better place. And soon, our dream will become a reality. Thanks to the JOBS Act, everyone — not just the wealthy — can invest as little as $100 in the startups they care about. Not only does this open up the pool of investors, and increase the amount of great ideas that get funded, but it allows startups to grow an army of passionate investors who truly want to see them succeed. Second tier VC’s will become obsolete as startups tap their lead users and customers for quick early investments.

name: Xendit
one_liner: Provides payment infrastructure for Southeast Asia
description:
Xendit provides payment solutions that simplify the payment process for businesses in Southeast Asia, including Indonesia, Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam from SMEs, e-commerce startups to giant corporations. 

Xendit provides a secure, easy-to-integrate payment system, and seamless payment experience supported by great customer service. With a diverse range of products, Xendit’s system can accept payments from virtual accounts, credit and debit cards, eWallets, retail outlets, and also online installments. 

With our aim to build Indonesia and the Philippines’s payment infrastructure, Xendit is on its way shaping the next generation of unicorns by empowering startups to grow exponentially through the products we offer. 

Xendit is licensed and regulated in multiple countries in Southeast Asia

name: XTraffic
one_liner: Technology for cities to automate and manage their traffic lights.
description: XTraffic is at the intersection of advancements in sensor technology and affordability. This means entire cities can affordably upgrade their infrastructure - and some already are. We are live in multiple cities, with both ongoing and successful pilots, corridors of multiple intersections, and soon to be entire cities. Our customers enjoy less traffic, better safety, and data on which to build their future.

name: You Got Listings
one_liner: All-in-one apartment Marketing Platform for brokerages and landlords.
description: You Got Listings is an all-in-one apartment Marketing Platform for brokerages and management companies. Founded in 2009, You Got Listings through innovation and automation has helped push over 3 Million properties in front of prospect renters. We are here to provide the rentals industry with the most comprehensive online marketing solution.
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

name: Zenflow
one_liner: Medical device that provides a more effective, less invasive…
description: Forty million men in the US and over 500 million worldwide suffer from urinary obstruction related to benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). The majority of men will experience symptoms of this disease at some point in life. BPH, also known as prostate enlargement, leads to urinary straining, frequency, urgency, and sleep disruption. Despite the high prevalence and significant quality of life burden of BPH, established treatments are limited to drugs, which have limited effectiveness, and surgery, which carries a high risk of sexual side effects. The Zenflow Spring is a small implant delivered in the urologist's office in a simple procedure that provides quick and long-lasting symptom relief.

name: Zenysis
one_liner: Building powerful data analysis software for developing countries.
description: Zenysis builds data integration software that helps governments view and analyze all their data in one place. When governments face pandemic emergencies, humanitarian crises, or natural disasters, they turn to their data for actionable insights. Zenysis puts this information at their fingertips.
